title: HouseGraph node catalog (catalogVersion 1)
description: The shape of `housegraph nodes list --json` (io.github.jaymcole.housegraph.catalog.NodeCatalog). catalogVersion changes only when a field is renamed or removed; a caller should refuse to parse a catalogVersion it does not recognise rather than guess at the shape.

type.description: The port's Java type, fully qualified (e.g. java.lang.Float).

required.description: Whether this input must have a value source for the node to be considered configured. Always false for an output.

type.description: The stable id this node type is written under in a save file (NodeRegistry.persistentTypeId).

category.description: Dot-separated Add-Node menu category; empty string for the top level.

kind.description: The node's declared NodeKind, or null when it declared none.

error.description: Present only when this node type could not be instantiated to read its shape (a broken constructor or static initializer). When present, inputs/outputs/flowInputs/flowOutputs/executionEntryPoint/defaultState/signature are all absent.

defaultState.description: A freshly-constructed instance's BaseNode.saveState() — the node's default params, for a type whose configuration is more than its input/output values.

signature.description: Same fingerprint as a save file's per-node 'nodeSignature' (see NodeSignature), computed from this freshly-instantiated node. A save whose recorded signature for a type differs from this one has drifted since it was saved — see 'nodes check'.
